judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the test-writing/planning phase and never actually modified the implementation in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` still overwrites `lastUsage = outcome.usage ?? lastUsage` instead of summing usage across rounds, the newly added acceptance test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.acceptance.test.ts` will fail immediately when run. Additionally, the candidate failed to update the hook signature parameter name (`totalUsage`), missed the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry, and left an untracked `.lore/dod.md` artifact in the tree. Only the spec update in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and the test scenarios themselves were completed.
